categories.name: Ibyapa biburira
categories.description: Mpandeshatu ifite umuzenguruko utukura: bikuburira ko imbere hari icyago, bigusaba kwitonda bidasanzwe.

categories.name: Ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere
categories.description: Bigena uzatambuka mbere mu nkomane cyangwa mu mfunganwa.

categories.name: Ibyapa bibuza
categories.description: Uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura: bikubuza igikorwa runaka.

categories.name: Ibyapa bitegeka
categories.description: Uruziga rw'ubururu: bigutegeka icyo ugomba gukora.

categories.name: Utwapa nyongera n'ibigoboka abagenzi
categories.description: Byuzuza ibindi byapa cyangwa byerekana serivisi ziri hafi.

categories.name: Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda
categories.description: Imirongo n'ibishushanyo biri mu muhanda ubwawo.

signs.name: Ikoni ibumoso
signs.description: Ahegereye ikoni riteza ibyago riri ibumoso.

signs.name: Ikoni iburyo
signs.description: Ahegereye ikoni riteza ibyago riri iburyo.

signs.name: Amakoni akurikiranye, irya mbere ibumoso
signs.description: Amakoni abiri cyangwa uruhererekane rw'amakoni arenga abiri, irya mbere riri ibumoso.

signs.name: Amakoni akurikiranye, irya mbere iburyo
signs.description: Amakoni abiri cyangwa uruhererekane rw'amakoni arenga abiri, irya mbere riri iburyo.

signs.name: Akamanuko gashobora gutera ibyago
signs.description: Ahegereye akamanuko gateye ibyago. Ikigereranyo gishobora kuzuzwa n'ingano y'agacuri ku ijana (%).

signs.name: Akazamuko gashinze cyane
signs.description: Ahegereye akazamuko gashinze cyane. Ikigereranyo gishobora kuzuzwa n'ingano y'agacuri ku ijana (%).

signs.name: Ifungana ry'umuhanda
signs.description: Ahegereye aho umuhanda ufungana ku mpande zombi.

signs.name: Ifungana ry'umuhanda ibumoso
signs.description: Umuhanda ufungana bitewe n'akayira gasatira umuhanda ku ruhande rw'ibumoso.

signs.name: Ifungana ry'umuhanda iburyo
signs.description: Umuhanda ufungana bitewe n'akayira gasatira umuhanda ku ruhande rw'iburyo.

signs.name: Uguhinguka ku mwaro
signs.description: Ahegereye aho umuhanda uhingukira ku mwaro, ku nkombe cyangwa ku cyome.

signs.name: Umuhanda utaringaniye
signs.description: Ahegereye ibinogo, utununga cyangwa ahantu umuhanda umeze nabi.

signs.name: Umuhanda unyerera
signs.description: Ahegereye igice cy'umuhanda gishobora kunyerera.

signs.name: Utubuye dutaruka
signs.description: Ahegereye igice cy'umuhanda aho utubuye dushobora gutaruka.

signs.name: Amabuye ahanuka
signs.description: Ahegereye igice cy'umuhanda gishobora kugwamo amabuye ahanuka cyangwa kubamo amabuye. Ikigereranyo gishobora gucurikwa bitewe n'uruhande ibyago biturukamo.

signs.name: Abanyamaguru
signs.description: Ahegereye inzira y'abanyamaguru.

signs.name: Abana
signs.description: Ahegereye aho abana banyura, nko hafi y'ishuri cyangwa y'ikibuga cy'imikino.

signs.name: Aho abanyamagare bahingukira
signs.description: Ahegereye aho abanyamagare binjirira mu muhanda cyangwa bawambukiranya.

signs.name: Akayira k'amatungo
signs.description: Igice cy'umuhanda gishobora kwambukiranywa n'amatungo ku buryo budasanzwe.

signs.name: Akayira k'inyamaswa
signs.description: Igice cy'umuhanda gishobora kwambukiranywa n'inyamaswa ku buryo budasanzwe.

signs.name: Imirimo
signs.description: Ahegereye igice cy'umuhanda gikorerwamo imirimo.

signs.name: Ibimenyetso bimurika
signs.description: Ahegereye aho kugendera mu muhanda bigengwa n'ibimenyetso by'amatara y'amabara atatu.

signs.name: Ikibuga cy'indege
signs.description: Ahegereye aho indege zigurukira hasi hejuru y'umuhanda zigwa cyangwa zihaguruka.

signs.name: Umuyaga w'intambike
signs.description: Ahegereye igice cy'umuhanda gikunze guhuhwamo n'inkubi y'umuyaga w'intambike.

signs.name: Umuhanda ubisikanirwamo
signs.description: Ahegereye igice cy'umuhanda kibisikanirwamo by'agateganyo cyangwa buri gihe, kandi mbere yacyo hagendwaga mu cyerekezo kimwe.

signs.name: Inkomane
signs.description: Ahegereye inkomane. Gutambuka mbere bikurikiza amategeko rusange: ureka ibinyabiziga bituruka iburyo bwawe.

signs.name: Umuhanda urasukira ibumoso
signs.description: Inkomane aho umuhanda urasukira ibumoso mu mfuruka yenda kuba igororotse. Gutambuka mbere hakurikijwe amategeko rusange.

signs.name: Umuhanda urasukira iburyo
signs.description: Inkomane aho umuhanda urasukira iburyo mu mfuruka yenda kuba igororotse. Gutambuka mbere hakurikijwe amategeko rusange.

signs.name: Umuhanda urasukira ibumoso mu mfuruka ifunganye
signs.description: Inkomane aho umuhanda urasukira ibumoso mu mfuruka ifunganye. Gutambuka mbere hakurikijwe amategeko rusange.

signs.name: Umuhanda urasukira iburyo mu mfuruka ifunganye
signs.description: Inkomane aho umuhanda urasukira iburyo mu mfuruka ifunganye. Gutambuka mbere hakurikijwe amategeko rusange.

signs.name: Amasangano ameze nka T
signs.description: Inkomane aho umuhanda ugana ibumoso n'iburyo, ariko umuhanda urimo ntukomeze.

signs.name: Amasangano ameze nka Y
signs.description: Inkomane aho umuhanda usatukamo imihanda ibiri itandukanye.

signs.name: Uruhererekane rw'inkomane
signs.description: Inkomane zikurikiranye. Gutambuka mbere hakurikijwe amategeko rusange.

signs.name: Inkomane ku muhanda utambukwamo mbere
signs.description: Ahegereye inkomane aho umuhanda urimo (ugaragazwa n'umurongo munini) utambukwamo mbere y'imihanda isanganya. Ibyapa A.22a kugeza kuri A.22e bizasimburwa n'ibyapa B.3.

signs.name: Inkomane ku muhanda utambukwamo mbere
signs.description: Umuhanda w'ibumoso urasukira mu muhanda wawe utambukwamo mbere. Ibyapa A.22 bizasimburwa n'ibyapa B.3.

signs.name: Inkomane ku muhanda utambukwamo mbere
signs.description: Umuhanda w'iburyo urasukira mu muhanda wawe utambukwamo mbere. Ibyapa A.22 bizasimburwa n'ibyapa B.3.

signs.name: Inkomane ku muhanda utambukwamo mbere
signs.description: Umuhanda urasukira ibumoso mu mfuruka ifunganye mu muhanda wawe utambukwamo mbere. Ibyapa A.22 bizasimburwa n'ibyapa B.3.

signs.name: Inkomane ku muhanda utambukwamo mbere
signs.description: Umuhanda urasukira iburyo mu mfuruka ifunganye mu muhanda wawe utambukwamo mbere. Ibyapa A.22 bizasimburwa n'ibyapa B.3.

signs.name: Ahegereye icyapa "Tanga inzira"
signs.description: Kimenyesha mbere (urugero: muri metero 200) ko ugiye kugera ahari icyapa B.1. Kizasimburwa n'icyapa B.1.

signs.name: Ahegereye icyapa "STOP"
signs.description: Ahegereye inkomane aho guhagarara akanya gato ari itegeko. Akapa nyongera kari munsi y'icyapa B.1 kerekana intera ibura ngo ugere ku cyapa STOP.

signs.name: Aho banyura bazengurutse
signs.description: Ahegereye inkomane banyuramo bategetswe kuzenguruka (giratoire).

signs.name: Gariyamoshi ifite bariyeri
signs.description: Ahegereye amasangano y'inzira nyabagendwa n'inzira ya gariyamoshi ibambiye (ifite bariyeri) hose cyangwa mu gice cyayo.

signs.name: Gariyamoshi idafite bariyeri
signs.description: Ahegereye amasangano y'inzira nyabagendwa n'inzira ya gariyamoshi itabambiye (idafite bariyeri).

signs.name: Gariyamoshi: hasigaye metero 150
signs.description: Akapa kariho imirongo itatu itukura iberamye, gashyirwa munsi ya A.26 cyangwa A.27 muri metero 150 mbere y'amasangano na gariyamoshi.

signs.name: Gariyamoshi: hasigaye metero 100
signs.description: Akapa kariho imirongo ibiri itukura iberamye, gashyirwa muri metero 100 mbere y'amasangano na gariyamoshi.

signs.name: Gariyamoshi: hasigaye metero 50
signs.description: Akapa kariho umurongo umwe utukura uberamye, gashyirwa muri metero 50 mbere y'amasangano na gariyamoshi.

signs.name: Ibyago
signs.description: Ahegereye icyago kidasobanuye ukundi.

signs.name: Imitemeri y'icyago
signs.description: Imitemeri ifite amabara atukura n'ayera asimburana: yerekana icyago kidahoraho, nk'impanuka cyangwa imirimo ikorwa mu muhanda, n'aho bayobereza umuhanda.

signs.name: Ibitembo by'icyago
signs.description: Ibitembo bifite amabara atukura n'ayera asimburana: byerekana icyago kidahoraho kandi bikayobora abagenzi.

signs.name: Tanga inzira
signs.description: Gitegeka umuyobozi ugeze ku nkomane guha inzira ibinyabiziga bigenda mu muhanda yegera, ibiturutse iburyo n'ibiturutse ibumoso.

signs.name: Hagarara (STOP)
signs.description: Gitegeka umuyobozi ugeze ku nkomane guhagarara akanya gato mbere yo kwinjira mu nkomane, no guha inzira ibinyabiziga bigenda mu muhanda yegera.

signs.name: Hagarara (STOP), icyapa cya kera
signs.description: Gisobanura kimwe n'icyapa B.2a. Ibyapa B.2b bizasimburwa buhoro buhoro n'ibyapa B.2a.

signs.name: Umuhanda utambukwamo mbere
signs.description: Kibwira abagenda muri uyu muhanda ko mu nkomane zawo n'indi mihanda, abaturuka mu yindi mihanda bagomba kubaha inzira.

signs.name: Iherezo ry'umuhanda utambukwamo mbere
signs.description: Kerekana aho uwo muhanda urekera gutambukwamo mbere y'iyindi.

signs.name: Tanga inzira ku biturutse imbere
signs.description: Birabujijwe kwinjira mu muhanda ufunganye aho kubisikana biruhije cyangwa bidashoboka, igihe ikinyabiziga kimwe cyangwa byinshi biturutse imbere bihagarara.

signs.name: Utambuka mbere y'ibiturutse imbere
signs.description: Kereka umuyobozi ugiye kwinjira mu mfunganwa ko afite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere y'ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere. Icyitonderwa: iyo ikizamuka n'ikimanuka bihuye, ikimanuka ni cyo gitanga inzira.

signs.name: Inkomane na gariyamoshi
signs.description: Kerekana inkomane y'umuhanda n'inzira ya gariyamoshi.

signs.name: Inkomane na gariyamoshi y'amashami abiri
signs.description: Kerekana ko inzira ya gariyamoshi ihura n'umuhanda ifite nibura amashami abiri.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa muri iki cyerekezo
signs.description: Nta kinyabiziga kihanyura mu cyerekezo uganamo.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa mu byerekezo byombi
signs.description: Habujijwe kunyurwa n'ikinyabiziga icyo ari cyo cyose, mu byerekezo byombi.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa uretse abahatuye
signs.description: Nta kinyabiziga kihanyura uretse iby'abahatuye n'ibigomba guhagarara mu gice cy'inzira giherwa n'iki kimenyetso.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bifite moteri
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ikinyabiziga icyo ari cyo cyose gifite moteri, uretse amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande na velomoteri.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'amapikipiki
signs.description: Birabujijwe kuhanyuza ipikipiki.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'amagare
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyamitende (amagare).

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa na velomoteri
signs.description: Birabujijwe kuhanyuza velomoteri.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'ibitwara ibicuruzwa
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara ibicuruzwa. Akapa nyongera gashobora kwerekana uburemere baheraho babuza.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'ibikurura romoruki
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ikinyabiziga icyo ari cyo cyose gikurura romoruki itari makuzungu cyangwa romoruki ifite umutambiko umwe.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'abanyamaguru
signs.description: Birabujijwe ko abanyamaguru bahanyura.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'ibikururwa n'inyamaswa
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bikururwa n'inyamaswa.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'utunyamitwaro dusunikwa
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'utunyamitwaro dusunikwa (ingorofani n'ibindi).

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'imashini zihinga
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bihinga bifite moteri.

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'amoko yerekanwe
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'amoko y'ibinyabiziga cyangwa abagenzi bashushanyijwe ku cyapa (urugero: imodoka n'ipikipiki).

signs.name: Ntihanyurwa n'amoko yerekanwe
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'amoko y'ibinyabiziga cyangwa abagenzi bashushanyijwe ku cyapa (urugero: ibikururwa n'inyamaswa).

signs.name: Ubugari ntarengwa
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari burenze ubwerekanwa ku cyapa (muri metero).

signs.name: Ubuhagarike ntarengwa
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bifite ubuhagarike, habariwemo imizigo, burenze ubwerekanwa ku cyapa (muri metero).

signs.name: Uburemere ntarengwa
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bifite uburemere burenze ubwerekanwa ku cyapa (muri toni).

signs.name: Uburemere ntarengwa ku mutambiko
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga bifite uburemere ku mutambiko burenze ubwerekanwa ku cyapa (muri toni).

signs.name: Uburebure ntarengwa
signs.description: Ntihanyurwa n'ibinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikomatanye bifite uburebure, habariwemo imizigo, burenze ubwerekanwa ku cyapa (muri metero).

signs.name: Intera ntarengwa hagati y'ibinyabiziga
signs.description: Birabujijwe kugenda udasize hagati yawe n'ikinyabiziga kikuri imbere intera nibura ingana n'iyerekanwe ku cyapa (muri metero).

signs.name: Birabujijwe gukatira ibumoso
signs.description: Birabujijwe gukata mu cyerekezo cyerekanwa n'akarangacyerekezo (ibumoso).

signs.name: Birabujijwe gukatira iburyo
signs.description: Birabujijwe gukata mu cyerekezo cyerekanwa n'akarangacyerekezo (iburyo).

signs.name: Birabujijwe guhindukira
signs.description: Birabujijwe guhindukira ugasubira inyuma (demi-tour).

signs.name: Birabujijwe kunyuranaho
signs.description: Birabujijwe kunyura ku binyabiziga byose, uretse ibinyamitende.

signs.name: Amakamyo abujijwe kunyuranaho
signs.description: Kubuza kunyuranaho ku binyabiziga bitwara ibicuruzwa bifite uburemere ntarengwa burenga toni 3,5. Akapa nyongera gashobora kwerekana ubundi buremere.

signs.name: Umuvuduko ntarengwa
signs.description: Umuvuduko ntugomba kurenga uwerekanwa ku cyapa (mu birometero ku isaha).

signs.name: Birabujijwe kuvuza amahoni
signs.description: Birabujijwe kuvuza ihoni, keretse iyo ari ukwirinda impanuka.

signs.name: Hagarara kuri gasutamo
signs.description: Birabujijwe gutambuka udahagaze akanya gato, kubera gasutamo cyangwa indi mpamvu yanditse ku cyapa.

signs.name: Iherezo ry'ibibuzwa byose
signs.description: Kerekana ko ibibuzwa byose byari byerekanywe n'ibyapa ku binyabiziga bigenda bitagikurikizwa.

signs.name: Iherezo ry'umuvuduko ntarengwa
signs.description: Kerekana ko umuvuduko ntarengwa werekanywe n'icyapa C.14 utagikurikizwa.

signs.name: Iherezo ryo kubuza kunyuranaho
signs.description: Kerekana ko kubuza kunyuranaho kwerekanywe n'icyapa C.13a (cyangwa C.13b) bitagikurikizwa.

signs.name: Birabujijwe guhagarara umwanya munini
signs.description: Kerekana aho ikinyabiziga gitangira kubuzwa guhagarara umwanya munini.

signs.name: Birabujijwe guhagarara umwanya muto n'umunini
signs.description: Kerekana aho ikinyabiziga gitangira kubuzwa guhagarara umwanya muto ndetse n'umwanya munini.

signs.name: Guhagarara bisimburana: iminsi 1-15
signs.description: Birabujijwe guhagarara umwanya munini ku ruhande iki cyapa kiriho mu minsi 15 ya mbere y'ukwezi.

signs.name: Guhagarara bisimburana: iminsi 16-31
signs.description: Birabujijwe guhagarara umwanya munini ku ruhande iki cyapa kiriho kuva ku munsi wa 16 kugeza ku munsi wa nyuma w'ukwezi.

signs.name: Icyerekezo gitegetswe: ibumoso
signs.description: Gitegeka buri kinyabiziga gukurikiza icyerekezo cyerekanwa n'akarangacyerekezo.

signs.name: Icyerekezo gitegetswe: kata iburyo
signs.description: Gitegeka buri kinyabiziga gukatira iburyo nk'uko akarangacyerekezo kabyerekana.

signs.name: Komeza imbere cyangwa ukatire iburyo
signs.description: Gitegeka kunyura muri kimwe mu byerekezo byerekanwa n'uturangacyerekezo.

signs.name: Komeza imbere
signs.description: Gitegeka buri kinyabiziga gukomeza imbere.

signs.name: Icyerekezo gitegetswe (impande zombi)
signs.description: Bisobanura kimwe na D.1a. Kerekana ko ibinyabiziga bishobora kunyura hirya no hino y'inkomyi iri mu nzira nyabagendwa.

signs.name: Uguhigama
signs.description: Mu nzira ifunganye, kerekana igice cyagutse aho ikinyabiziga gihagarara kugira ngo giheze umwanya ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere.

signs.name: Ugukikira bitegetswe
signs.description: Gishyirwa ku buhungiro cyangwa imbere y'inkomyi: gitegeka kunyura mu ruhande rwerekanwa n'akarangacyerekezo.

signs.name: Inkomane banyuramo bazengurutse
signs.description: Gitegeka buri kinyabiziga gukurikiza amategeko agenga inkomane banyuramo bazengurutse.

signs.name: Inzira y'amagare itegetswe
signs.description: Gitegeka abatwara amagare na velomoteri kunyura muri iyo nzira. Ibindi binyabiziga ntibiyitira.

signs.name: Inzira y'abanyamaguru itegetswe
signs.description: Gitegeka abanyamaguru kunyura muri iyo nzira, kikabuza abandi bagenzi kuyinyuramo.

signs.name: Inzira y'abagendera ku mafarasi
signs.description: Kimenyesha abagendera ku mafarasi ko bagomba kunyura muri iyo nzira, kikabuza abandi kuyinyuramo.

signs.name: Inzira y'amatungo itegetswe
signs.description: Kimenyesha abayobozi b'amatungo ko bagomba kuyanyuza muri iyo nzira.

signs.name: Umuvuduko muto ntarengwa
signs.description: Ibinyabiziga biri muri iyo nzira bigomba kugira nibura umuvuduko werekanwe (mu birometero ku isaha).

signs.name: Iherezo ry'umuvuduko muto ntarengwa
signs.description: Kerekana aho umuvuduko muto wari utegetswe n'icyapa D.8 utagitegetswe.

signs.name: Kumenyesha mbere icyerekezo
signs.description: Urugero rw'icyapa kimenyesha abagenzi ibyerekezo biri mu masangano begereye.

signs.name: Kumenyesha mbere icyerekezo
signs.description: Urugero rw'icyapa kimenyesha ibyerekezo by'amasangano ameze nka Y.

signs.name: Kumenyesha mbere icyerekezo
signs.description: Urugero rw'icyapa kimenyesha ibyerekezo n'intera bijyayo.

signs.name: Umuhanda udakomeza
signs.description: Urugero rw'icyapa kimenyesha mbere ko umuhanda wo ku ruhande udakomeza.

signs.name: Umuhanda udakomeza
signs.description: Urugero rw'icyapa kimenyesha mbere ko umuhanda udakomeza.

signs.name: Inzira igomba kunyurwamo
signs.description: Kimenyesha mbere inzira yo kunyuramo ngo ufate icyerekezo cy'ibumoso, igihe gukatira ibumoso bibujijwe mu nkomane ikurikira.

signs.name: Igisate cyo gufata
signs.description: Kimenyesha mbere igisate cy'umuhanda ugomba gufata bitewe n'icyerekezo ushaka gufata mu nkomane.

signs.name: Icyerekezo cy'ahantu
signs.description: Urugero rw'icyapa kiranga icyerekezo n'intera bijya ahantu runaka.

signs.name: Icyerekezo cy'ahantu
signs.description: Urugero rw'icyapa kiranga ibyerekezo bijya mu turere dutandukanye.

signs.name: Kuyobya umuhanda (DEVIATION)
signs.description: Kerekana icyerekezo cyo gukurikira igihe inzira yahinduwe kubera imirimo.

signs.name: Ikibuga cy'indege
signs.description: Kerekana icyerekezo cy'ikibuga cy'indege.

signs.name: Ikibanza cy'ingando
signs.description: Kerekana aho ikibanza cy'ingando giherereye.

signs.name: Icumbi ry'urubyiruko
signs.description: Kerekana aho icumbi ry'urubyiruko riherereye.

signs.name: Kwinjira mu nsisiro
signs.description: Kimenyesha ko winjiye mu nsisiro (umudugudu cyangwa umujyi). Amategeko yo mu nsisiro, nk'umuvuduko ntarengwa, atangira gukurikizwa.

signs.name: Iherezo ry'insisiro
signs.description: Kerekana iherezo ry'insisiro (umudugudu cyangwa umujyi).

signs.name: Inzira y'abanyamaguru
signs.description: Kereka abanyamaguru n'abayobozi aho inzira y'abanyamaguru iri.

signs.name: Ibitaro
signs.description: Gisaba abayobozi kwitonda hafi y'amavuriro, cyane cyane birinda urusaku rw'amahoni n'urwa moteri.

signs.name: Icyerekezo kimwe
signs.description: Iyo giteye nyanguni ku murongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri, cyemeza ko uri mu nzira y'icyerekezo kimwe.

signs.name: Icyerekezo kimwe
signs.description: Iyo giteye kibangikanye n'umuhanda, cyemeza ko umuhanda ugana mu cyerekezo cy'akarangacyerekezo ari uw'icyerekezo kimwe.

signs.name: Inzira idakomeza
signs.description: Kerekana ko inzira giteyeho idakomeza (impera y'inzira).

signs.name: Umuhanda urombereje w'ibice byinshi
signs.description: Kerekana aho amategeko yo kugendera mu muhanda urombereje w'ibisate byinshi (autoroute) atangirira gukurikizwa.

signs.name: Iherezo ry'umuhanda urombereje
signs.description: Kerekana aho amategeko yihariye y'umuhanda urombereje w'ibisate byinshi atagikurikizwa.

signs.name: Umuhanda ugenewe imodoka
signs.description: Kerekana aho amategeko yihariye y'umuhanda ugenewe imodoka atangirira; ntiwunyurwamo n'abanyamaguru cyangwa amatungo.

signs.name: Iherezo ry'umuhanda ugenewe imodoka
signs.description: Kerekana aho amategeko y'icyapa E.17 atagikurikizwa.

signs.name: Aho bisi zihagarara
signs.description: Kerekana ahagenewe guhagararwamo n'imodoka nini zitwara abantu muri rusange.

signs.name: Parikingi
signs.description: Kerekana ahantu hagenewe guhagararamo umwanya munini.

signs.name: Amabwiriza yihariye
signs.description: Kerekana ko hari amabwiriza yihariye yo kugendera mu cyambu cyangwa ku kibuga cy'indege.

signs.name: Intera
signs.description: Akapa kerekana intera iri hagati y'icyapa n'aho icyago gitangirira cyangwa aho amabwiriza y'icyapa atangira gukurikizwa.

signs.name: Uburebure bw'igice
signs.description: Akapa kerekana uburebure bw'igice giteza ibyago cyangwa bw'ahantu amabwiriza y'icyapa akurikizwa.

signs.name: Intera yo kubuza (imbere)
signs.description: Iyo gashyizwe kateganye n'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri, kerekana ahantu habujijwe guhagarara, hakurikijwe icyerekezo cy'akarangacyerekezo.

signs.name: Intera yo kubuza (impande zombi)
signs.description: Kerekana ko ibibujijwe bireba impande zombi z'icyapa ku ntera yerekanwe.

signs.name: Intera yo kubuza (inyuma)
signs.description: Kerekana intera ibibujijwe bireba, ku ruhande rwerekanwa n'akarangacyerekezo.

signs.name: Ibibuzwa bireba imbere
signs.description: Akapa kareba igice cy'umuhanda kiri hirya y'ikimenyetso.

signs.name: Ibibuzwa bireba impande zombi
signs.description: Akapa kareba ibice by'umuhanda biri hirya no hino y'ikimenyetso.

signs.name: Ibibuzwa bireba inyuma
signs.description: Akapa kareba igice cy'umuhanda kiri hino y'ikimenyetso.

signs.name: Ikintu ngoboka
signs.description: Kerekana ikintu ngoboka gishushanyije ku buso bwera bw'icyapa. Ibyapa F.6 kugeza kuri F.18 ni ingero zacyo.

signs.name: Ahari ubutabazi
signs.description: Kerekana ahari ubutabazi bw'ibanze.

signs.name: Aho bagobokera ibinyabiziga
signs.description: Kerekana aho bakorera cyangwa bagobokera ibinyabiziga (garaje).

signs.name: Ahari telefone
signs.description: Kerekana ahari telefone.

signs.name: Ahari lisansi na mazutu
signs.description: Kerekana sitasiyo y'ibikomoka kuri peteroli.

signs.name: Hoteli cyangwa icumbi
signs.description: Kerekana hoteli cyangwa ahari icumbi ry'abagenzi.

signs.name: Aho bafatira ifunguro
signs.description: Kerekana resitora cyangwa aho bafatira ifunguro.

signs.name: Urunywero cyangwa urusamuriro
signs.description: Kerekana aho banywera cyangwa basamurira.

signs.name: Ahateganyirijwe abahisi
signs.description: Kerekana ahateganyirijwe kuruhukira no gufatira amafunguro abahisi.

signs.name: Aho bahagurukira batembera n'amaguru
signs.description: Kerekana aho urugendo rwo gutembera n'amaguru rutangirira.

signs.name: Ikibanza cy'ingando
signs.description: Kerekana ikibanza cy'ingando.

signs.name: Ikibanza cya karavani
signs.description: Kerekana ikibanza cyagenewe amazu yimukanwa akururwa n'imodoka (karavani).

signs.name: Ikibanza cy'ingando na karavani
signs.description: Kerekana ikibanza cy'ingando cyakira n'amazu yimukanwa.

signs.name: Icumbi ry'urubyiruko
signs.description: Kerekana icumbi ry'urubyiruko.

signs.name: Umurongo wera udacagaguye
signs.description: Umuyobozi wese abujijwe kuwurenga (ingingo ya 110).

signs.name: Umurongo wera ucagaguye
signs.description: Abujijwe kuwurenga keretse iyo anyura ku kindi kinyabiziga, akatira ibumoso, ahindukira cyangwa ajya mu kindi gisate cy'umuhanda.

signs.name: Uduce tugufi twegeranye
signs.description: Uduce tw'umurongo tugufi kandi twegeranye twerekana ko umurongo udacagaguye wegereje: ntukawurenge.

signs.name: Umurongo udacagaguye n'ucagaguye bibangikanye
signs.description: Umuyobozi yita gusa ku murongo umwegereye. Ushobora kurenga ucagaguye uri ku ruhande rwawe, ariko ntiwarenga udacagaguye uri ku ruhande rwawe.

signs.name: Igisate cy'ibitwara abantu muri rusange
signs.description: Igice gikikijwe n'uduce tugari tw'ibara ryera: gitegeka ibinyabiziga bitwara abantu muri rusange n'ibigenda buhoro kukinyuramo.

signs.name: Inzira y'amagare
signs.description: Igice kigarukira ku mirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye, kidafite ubugari buhagije ku modoka: ni inzira y'ibinyamitende.

signs.name: Umurongo wera ku nkengero y'umuhanda
signs.description: Werekana aho umuhanda ugarukira; birabujijwe kuwurenga ugenda, uhagarara umwanya muto cyangwa umunini ku nkengero.

signs.name: Umurongo w'umuhondo ucagaguye ku nkengero
signs.description: Bibujijwe guhagarara umwanya munini ku burebure bw'uwo murongo.

signs.name: Umurongo wera mugari w'inkengero itari nyayo
signs.description: Igice cy'umuhanda kiri hirya y'uwo murongo kigenewe guhagararwamo umwanya muto cyangwa munini.

signs.name: Imirongo yera yambukiranya y'aho bahagarara
signs.description: Yerekana itangiriro n'iherezo by'ahantu hahagararwa, n'imyanya ibinyabiziga bihagararamo.
